output:
**What I found:** The line-limit gate can't fail. Every time it goes red, a script rewrites the exception list to match the current code, so 17 modules were added to it in 12 days and no commit said so. The fix is to let the script only shrink the list and to make every addition name the module and the reason (the record calls this RATCHET). The deciding fact is that the list grew from 41 to 58 across 34 rewrites while the gate stayed green.

**Why it matters:** Right now the gate just records whatever exists. Each oversized module is excused the moment it appears, and if the JSON only lists module names, the 58 excused modules can grow without any limit. If nothing changes, the list keeps growing at about 1.4 modules a day and the gate keeps reporting green.

**Do this first:**
1. Replace the regeneration script with a reconcile step (algorithm in `.claude/skills/gate-lifecycle/references/ratchet.md`):
   - A new oversized module, or a listed module that got bigger, fails the gate unless the change names it with `--accept-growth <path>`.
   - A red run never writes the JSON.
   - A module that is now under the limit is removed from the list automatically.
   - The refused case is unit-tested, and that test is the gate's negative control: proof it can still fail.
2. Store each listed module's current line count, not just its name, so "bigger than its baseline" fails too.
3. Diff the baseline from 12 days ago against the current one to get the 17 additions. The list's owner fixes each one or accepts it by name in one commit with a reason per module. Don't drop all 17 back to red at once: that would block every merge.

**What I did not check:**
- The repository, the script, the JSON and the history. This directory has no git repo, so everything comes from your description. Run `git log -p -- <baseline.json>` in the real repo.
- Whether the JSON stores sizes or only names. Read the file.
- Whether listed modules have already grown. Compare `wc -l` per module against the size each had when it was first listed.

```text
Gate:         Per-module line-limit check with a JSON exception baseline, merge gate in CI
Stage:        unplaced (merge-time CI; nothing earlier was described)
Trigger:      churn
Proof:        UNPROVEN (it has gone red, but each red run was turned green by regenerating; there is no committed negative control)
Scope:        declared all source modules / effective modules not in the regenerated list / delta every oversized module at the moment it appears (17 in 12 days), and listed modules' size if the baseline stores only names
Baseline:     58 entries, up from 41 over 12 days (34 rewrites); last accepted growth: none named in any commit
Status:       BLOCKING (in name only)
Decision:     RATCHET
Guard:        Unnamed growth refused by reconcile; a red run writes nothing; the list has a named owner (not yet assigned)
Handoff:      none (PROVE follows once the reconcile refused-case test runs in CI)
Next action:  Replace the regenerate-on-red script with reconcile + per-entry --accept-growth, then triage the 17 additions in one named commit
Verification: Not run (no repository in the working directory); target is a CI run where an unnamed new oversized module turns the gate red and the JSON is unchanged
```
